_note: Enforcement layer over eval/seed_policy.py, which is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for reserved
seed blocks (EVAL-DESIGN.md §6.5, locked 2026-07-25, user-approved). This file never restates a
reserved block — seed_registry.py derives those directly from seed_policy.RESERVED_BLOCKS, and
refuses to load if any bank declared here reaches into one. What it adds is the machinery
seed_policy.py deliberately does not have: which seeds are already spent, which open-lane seeds
an eval has claimed, and a live scan of datasets/*/meta.jsonl to prove the promise was kept.
eval-only  MUST NOT appear in any training corpus. A hit fails `seed_registry.py check`.
train      Harvestable. A cited eval MUST NOT draw from these, harvested yet or not.
harness    Zero-model mechanical validation (canaries, smoke). Never a strength claim.
`burned` marks seeds inside an eval-only band that were spent BEFORE the band meant anything.
Mirrors `grandfathered` in eval/holdouts.json. Burned seeds do not fail the contamination check
— permanently-red gates get ignored — but are refused for any cited eval.
`at_risk: true` marks a band claimed inside seed_policy's OPEN 1000-8999 lane. seed_policy.py
does not protect it, so make_sft_data.py will not refuse it: only the corpus scan here stands
between such a band and a future harvest. Recorded honestly rather than described as reserved.
_derived_burns_note: seed_policy.py describes frozen-legacy (501-525) as 'burned for held-out measurement, kept for
tracking continuity'. That is exactly this file's `burned` semantics, so the whole block is
marked spent. Confirmed by measurement, not just by the doc: 13 of the 25 seeds appear in
datasets/stage1-v1, which is why runs/stage1-student-eval and runs/stage2-student-eval are not
defensible as held-out numbers (52% contaminated — see `seed_registry.py audit`).

banks.name: stage3-holdout
banks.purpose: Claimed for the stage3 student eval (eval/suites/stage3-v1.json). Sits in seed_policy's OPEN 1000-8999 dev/exploratory lane, chosen because a 1240-game development measurement is not a release certification and must not burn the 100-seat certification-holdout block, which is opened once at release and then retired. Verified clean when claimed: the highest seed in any corpus was 6529 on 2026-07-26. at_risk because seed_policy.py does not guard the open lane — if a future corpus build harvests from here, `seed_registry.py check` fails and this band must be re-cut, not quietly re-labelled.

banks.name: dev-lane
banks.purpose: seed_policy's open development / exploratory / SPRT lane, minus the stage3-holdout claim. Harvestable into training corpora: D1 self-play and the R2 teacher corpora already live here (datasets/stage2-local-v0, stage2-local-v1-dagger, stage2-r2-teacher-v0).

banks.name: canary
banks.purpose: Floor-mirror and shadow canaries (seed 42: identity A wins after 108 turns, bit-reproducible). Listed as burned-and-kept in EVAL-DESIGN.md §6.5. See CLAUDE.md validation ladder step 1.

banks.name: smoke
banks.purpose: Smoke batches: floor-vs-random, floor-vs-ai, haiku-vs-* plumbing runs. Split around the seed-7 canary.

banks.name: stage0-legacy
banks.purpose: A/B preamble and quality runs, harvested into datasets/stage1-v0 and stage1-v1. Distinct from the 501-525 frozen-legacy block, which seed_policy.py reserves.

banks.name: dagger-undeclared
banks.purpose: Territory no seed_policy block covers. runs/d4-dagger-pilot (9001) and runs/d4-dagger-r1 (9100-9102) played here and datasets/stage2-local-v1-dagger harvested the latter, so it is training territory in practice. Declared explicitly so those seeds classify as train rather than silently reading as 'unregistered'. eval/suites/stage3-v1.json originally banked here; it now uses stage3-holdout.
